_doc: Visual overlay distilled by looking at every option thumbnail in assets/options (2026-10-05). taxonomy.json fragments are 2-4 word labels; these descriptors carry the actual look of the reference image into the prompt. Overlay only — taxonomy.json stays the upstream truth. 'look' = what to write in the prompt; 'card_styling' = the styling the reference card itself uses (inspiration, optional, never forced).
house_style: Every reference card shares one aesthetic: plain white/light-grey studio, frontal symmetrical framing, completely deadpan face, bold saturated single-colour wardrobe, one exaggerated feature, editorial-photoreal skin. Keep this unless the user asks otherwise.
